Definition: to associate; by implication, to overshadow (by huddling together)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dim, darken, grow dark; 1a) (Qal) to dim, eclipse, be held dark; 1b) (Hophal) to be dimmed, grow dark
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
